question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Keep in check
solution:
The correct answer is '**To control something**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Given Idiom: *Keep in check* means **to keep someone or something under control**. (किसी को या किसी चीज को नियंत्रण में रखना)

 
 
• Example:* Hemant was a remarkable man but very difficult to **keep in check***.
 
 
 
• From the given options, the third option is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

 
• We may think from the phrase "Keep in check" that it is all about testing something.
